title: Northgate Protect Settlement Terms: Limit of Liability, Repair, Replacement and Reimbursement
content:
Keystone Protection Services settles approved Northgate Protect claims on the terms below. Each covered item has a limit of liability equal to the net price paid for the item before tax.

## Settlement terms by tier

| Term | Standard 2-Year | Standard 3-Year | Accident 2-Year | Accident 3-Year | Accident 4-Year | Complete Monthly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Limit of liability per covered item | Item net price | Item net price | Item net price | Item net price | Item net price | Item net price |
| Most paid on all claims in a rolling 12 months | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | $5000.00 |
| Repairable item repaired before replacement is considered | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Repair estimate, as percent of item net price, above which the item is replaced | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 |
| Completed repairs for the same failure after which the next qualifying failure is replaced | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Plan fulfilled and ended once its item is replaced or reimbursed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No (continues for other items) |

## What a replacement and a reimbursement provide (all tiers)

- **Replacement:** a new item of like kind and quality with equal or better features, not exceeding the item's net price.
- **Reimbursement**, used when no replacement is available: paid as a Northgate eGift Card, for the covered item's net price minus all earlier settlements on that item.

## Points of judgement

- The rolling-12-month payout maximum of $5000.00 exists on Northgate Protect Complete Monthly only.
- *Hypothetical:* on an item with a net price of $1,000.00, a repair estimate of $800.00 is not above 80 percent of the net price, while an estimate of $800.01 is.
- A single-item plan ends as fulfilled when its item is replaced or reimbursed; Complete Monthly keeps running for its other registered items.
